evals.description: A sign-in return parameter sends readers to whatever host it names.
Throttle a public search endpoint per address, with a counter that expires itself.
A job picked up before its transaction commits cannot find the file it was sent for.
A long job restarted by a deploy begins again at the first row, mangling what it already did.
Announce exactly once per going-live, whatever else the same save did.
Read rows at destroy time that dependent: :destroy has already deleted.
All-or-nothing import: a guard return must not commit half the work.
One insert for a whole roster, notifications only for grants that stuck.
A mis-quoted identifier makes the monthly compaction sort by the literal string.
Erase an account and everything of theirs, including rows reachable only indirectly.
A commit callback fills a cache from a stale copy of the record.
Add tenants and close every cross-tenant read, including routes that never load a Book.
Free the file and the blob behind a deleted page, superseded revisions included.
The preprocessed variant never matches the one requested, so every upload converts twice.
An unscoped collection cache serves the first viewer's controls to everyone.
A Turbo broadcast still reaches collaborators whose access was revoked.
Close four defects from an audit list that states properties, never bugs.
An unscoped cache key serves one user's library digest to everyone.
Sweep every removed Active Support conversion, including the no-argument aliases.
Add terminal output to a runner script without losing its log file.
An order-dependent suite flake from a helper leaking a process-wide toggle.
